definition.simple: The difference between the spot price of something and the price of a futures contract on it.
definition.balanced: Often defined as spot − futures, though some sources use futures − spot, so check which is meant. Basis tends to shrink toward zero as [[expiry]] nears, but it can widen or narrow along the way.

example: Fictional: spot 50.00, near-month future 50.60. Basis (spot − futures) = −0.60.
